status: Specified before implementing and measuring this candidate. Local development experiment using familiar fixtures and seeds, not public preregistration or held-out validation.
hypothesis: A 50/50 blend of individual and team-average damage credit improves adaptation to feints by crediting helpful teammates without materially harming reversal adaptation.

reference.reuse: Reuse all original online/frozen/uniform/fixed traces only after every original source identity passes verification and a complete fresh replay of the first seed exactly matches its recorded trial. Reused encounters are not counted as newly executed.

reward.team_evidence: Sum damage only from enemies with a legitimate sighting in this direct-observation encounter. Divide by the original three roles, not current survivors. Own observation gate is unchanged; unobserved or frozen decisions cannot update.
reward.choice: One candidate, chosen without a weight sweep. Equal blending retains individual credit while exposing team contributions on a comparable damage scale.

uncertainty.method: Paired percentile bootstrap of per-seed mean differences; never resample individual rounds as independent units.
uncertainty.scope: Intervals describe tactic-sampling variation for these fixed controllers and this one map. They exclude map, player and population variation. Secondary intervals are exploratory and unadjusted for multiple comparisons.

branching: Train the candidate from fresh memory for each matched seed. For each movement switch, branch candidate online and frozen from its own exact trained snapshot including RNG. Original and candidate training histories may differ; this measures each rule throughout training and adaptation, not a reward-only intervention on a shared old checkpoint.

gates.decision: Advance only if all five gates pass in late rounds 17-24. Feint gains must be useful and exceed seed noise; reversal tolerates at most 3 HP loss at the interval lower bound. Keep cover as the original negative control. A failed conjunction means do not promote this candidate to the game. No thresholds or candidate weights change after results.

secondary_metrics: Four-round damage curves and early/late windows
Damage against fixed and uniform baselines
Accepted rewards, own and observed-team damage, defeat state for every feedback
invariants: Original v1 evidence and hashed sources remain unchanged
Only host reward attribution changes; no simulator, stats, weapons, tactics, learner config, controller or observation change
No player style label is supplied to reward computation or policy
Candidate feedback and displayed recorded rewards must agree
Frozen memories are exact; first combat matches within each online/frozen pair
All seeds, rounds and failures retained; never overwrite evidence
limits: Only tactic sampling is seeded; one map and known scripted controllers
Fixed baseline was selected on orbit/reverse/cover, not fresh held-out scenarios
Rewards describe effectiveness, not fun; human experience is unmeasured
Team-average credit is not a causal contribution estimator; it may dilute individual credit
Intervals describe policy-seed variation, not people, maps or worlds; secondary analyses exploratory
A favorable result permits a next playtest decision, not a broad public effectiveness claim
